_comment: The Aj face for the pipeline actor (stagekit.aj_face). The mouth is a drawn 2D atlas on the head: the skin material's node group 'Aj_Mouth_Controller' shows cell round(Mouth_Index) of Aj_Mouth_Atlas.png (4 columns x 3 rows, cell 0 top left, read left to right). The mouth is never changed in 3D: Jaw_Drop and every mouth shape key stay untouched. Expressions set brow and eye shape keys plus one mouth cell; visemes (while speaking) pick a mouth cell; the cell is keyed with constant interpolation so it switches like a drawn mouth. Values are 0..1 at amount 1.

cells.0: neutral: closed lips, a soft line
cells.1: smile with the upper teeth showing
cells.2: wide open mouth, teeth and tongue (a shout, 'ah', crying)
cells.5: big toothy grin, teeth together, wide
cells.8: flat closed line (lips pressed: m, b, p; sleepy)
cells.9: flat with the teeth showing (e, i, tight)

eyes._comment: look_x +1 = toward the figure's own left (+X in its model space), -1 = its right; look_z +1 = up. Verified on a render (docs in tools/chars_aj/look_aj.py output).
